notes: Clips are baked from the rig's evaluated pose (grips, the hand's hold on the bow, forearm twist, the cape and the keyed bow and string); no constraints or drivers go out. The props are skinned to the bones Bow (child of mixamorig:LeftHand), Quiver (child of mixamorig:Spine2) and Arrow (child of mixamorig:RightHand); the string's middle to String (child of Bow), which the shot draws.

attack is the shot: events.draw is when the arrow appears in his right fist above his shoulder, events.nock when its nock goes on the string, events.shot when he looses (shot_from is the arrow's middle at that frame, Godot axes from his feet; it points aim_up_deg above level and aim_yaw_deg off his facing, positive to his left). The arrow shows only in events.arrow_shown; elsewhere, and in every other clip, the Arrow bone is at zero scale. The last held_frames frames hold the follow-through. No reload clip: the shot draws its own arrow.

Locomotion is in place. walk and run move the figure by root_vel (m/s, Godot axes): the travel retarget_clips.py removed (travel_from); speed_footlock_mps is how fast his planted foot slides back. idle stands still. block and death keep their authored travel on the hips (root_motion true, hips_drift); do not add it again.
block is the source's hit reaction (he crouches and raises the bow across his body), so it is his hit role.
death: events.bow_drop is when he lets go of the bow; the Bow bone then lays it flat on the ground.
Godot imports every clip with loop mode none; set it from clips.<clip>.loop. Animation names equal the clip names (clips.<clip>.anim).
